title: India’s biggest urban problem might not be potholes. It could be us
content: Indian cities invest heavily in infrastructure, yet many problems arise from everyday human behavior.  Overflowing bins and parked cars on sidewalks highlight this ongoing civic failure.  Traffic rule violations and littering demonstrate a cultural contradiction in public space treatment.  Keeping cities clean requires municipal systems, enforcement, and citizen behavior working together.  Becoming smarter citizens is the real test of India's urban transformation.

title: 'Gob-smacking shambles': Bangladesh humiliation puts ageing Aussies on notice

title: MacKenzie Scott helped abolish $40bn in medical debt; how mechanics work
content: MacKenzie Scott's philanthropic efforts have made a significant impact by enabling the cancellation of medical debt across the United States. By purchasing and eliminating patient debt at a minimal cost, she has set a precedent that encourages other wealthy individuals to invest in similar initiatives. Despite these immediate acts of generosity, the need for comprehensive policy reforms persists, as true transformation necessitates addressing the fundamental issues leading to medical debt.

title: Michigan kids' lemonade stand raises over $1,000 after teen cheerleader's death
content: In Lambertville, Michigan, children set up a heartfelt lemonade stand to honor Lainey Scroggs, successfully raising over one thousand dollars for her family in their time of sorrow. Meanwhile, an online fundraiser has collected nearly seventy-four thousand dollars for the Scroggs family. These community-driven efforts exemplify profound compassion and unity, offering both emotional and financial support to the grieving relatives.

title: 88-year-old Arizona man and dog saved by SOS text after getting stuck in mud
content: A harrowing night unfolded for an 88-year-old man and his canine companion in Yavapai County when their vehicle became immobilized in thick mud from recent monsoon storms. An emergency SOS text sent out in distress helped authorities track them down. Fortunately, rescue teams reached them safely early Friday, aptly emphasizing the value of emergency communication features during critical situations.

title: Accenture CEO Julie Sweet makes a 'vacation request' to employees for this month
content: Accenture's CEO, Julie Sweet, has requested that employees delay their vacation in August. This temporary policy adjustment is designed to bolster staff presence as the company approaches the end of its financial year. Following disappointing quarterly results and a forecasted drop in revenue, Accenture is permitting employees to carry over unused vacation days into the next fiscal year to help enhance fourth-quarter outputs and revenue generation.

title: Quote of the day from Antonio Banderas
content: Antonio Banderas showcases the importance of following one's instincts over societal expectations. Hailing from Spain, he ascended to prominence in Hollywood while also dabbling in the realms of winemaking and fragrance. His near-fatal heart attack in 2017 prompted a thorough reassessment of his priorities. Despite the challenges, Banderas remains a captivating presence on screen, recently gracing audiences with his role in 'Tony'.

title: Wife’s death spurs Maharashtra man to build village road
content: Villagers in Ghodankappi are building their own road after a woman's death highlighted connectivity issues. Tulsiram Gedam mobilized residents to construct the vital 1.5-km stretch. This initiative underscores the administration's failure to provide basic infrastructure to remote settlements. The villagers seek safe access for children, elderly, and patients. Administration has now initiated steps to improve the village's road connectivity.

title: Rs 16-for-16-minute offer sparks chaos at Kanpur market, FIR lodged
content: The unveiling of a Rs 16 garment promo ignited pandemonium in Kanpur's Alam Market, with throngs of people converging and causing significant traffic snarls and a near-stampede scenario. Law enforcement quickly acted to clear the scene once the store closed. The turmoil left several shoppers injured, prompting police to file an FIR against the shop owner and other responsible individuals.

title: Buying property near beaches or water bodies? 10 laws and rules buyers should know
content: Investing in waterfront properties necessitates a solid grasp of environmental and land-use regulations. Essential guidelines include the Coastal Regulation Zone Notification 2019 and the Wetlands Rules 2017. The Environment Protection Act 1986 offers a comprehensive legal framework for these locations. It’s imperative for buyers to confirm property titles and access rights according to the relevant laws. Additionally, local building and zoning regulations outline what constructions are permissible.

title: UP horror: Man assaults delivery agent over ‘small’ delay, arrested
content: A delivery executive faced assault from a customer in Meerut over a slight order delay. The customer, a bank manager, allegedly threatened the worker with false accusations. CCTV footage captured the altercation before the worker was taken inside the flat. The victim reported threats of death and attempts to steal his money. Police arrested the accused manager and registered a case against him.

title: Max Holloway questions Islam Makhachev’s two-belt celebration after UFC 330
content: Islam Makhachev successfully defended his welterweight title at UFC 330. Max Holloway questioned why Makhachev celebrated with two championship belts. Makhachev previously vacated his lightweight title before moving divisions. The Russian secured a unanimous decision win against Ian Machado Garry. This victory extended Makhachev's impressive UFC winning streak to seventeen fights.

Deol also paid homage to Dara Singh’s legendary depiction of Hanuman, eagerly anticipating the film's November 2026 release.

title: Suriya's 'Vishwanath and Sons' sees decent Monday run

The film continues to perform well through its initial weekdays, with the Tamil version garnering Rs 67 lakh and the Telugu version adding Rs 50 lakh. Overall, the film's net collection in India has climbed to around Rs 59.32 crore.

title: Odisha removes six-attempt cap for OCS exam, general candidates can now appear till age 42

Under the revised rules, eligible unreserved-category aspirants can now take the exam repeatedly until they reach the upper age limit of 42 years. The state has also expanded free textbooks to Classes IX and X and announced plans to strengthen school education.

An argument escalated, and Manjath reportedly grabbed the constable by his collar. A viral video shows Manjath speaking to a senior officer and attempting to kick the constable. Police registered a case and subsequently arrested Manjath for obstructing a public servant.

content: Rohan Naidu, an astronomer from Hyderabad, is making significant contributions to our understanding of the early universe. His recent study focuses on a cosmic dawn object that reveals a supermassive black hole enveloped by dense gas. This important research not only sheds light on the rapid growth of early black holes but may also provide insights into the enigmatic 'little red dots' recently detected by the Webb telescope.

title: Disproportionate assets case: SC asks Allahabad HC not to proceed against Rahul
content: the apex court asked the Allahabad high court not to proceed with case against Rahul Gandhi . the top court also directed the CBI and Enforcement Directorate not to submit any probe report to any authority . if the complainant’s allegations were found to be true, the matter would amount to a “gross disproportionate assets case”

title: 'Tent fell, barricades collapsed': Stampede-like situation at Ujjain temple leaves devotees injured
content: a stampede-like situation broke out near the Mahakaleshwar Temple complex . the incident was reported near Harsiddhi Chauraha after a rumour about electric current in barricades triggered panic among devotees heading towards the Shri Nagchandreshwar temple .

title: How Trump bypassed Iran's negotiators and used Kurdistan's Barzani to contact IRGC

title: Iran nuclear post: How a fabricated X claim by Indian account created panic in Israel, US
content: the false claim emerged on august 5 when an anonymous account on X in India posted that Brig. Gen. Ahmad Vahidi had said Iran would not abandon its nuclear weapons ambitions as long as Israel and the United States possessed such weapons . the claim quickly gained traction, with Israeli accounts and media outlets repeating it before it reached senior political figures in the united states .

title: USS Benfold spent 4 days without toilets, AC, galley after power failure in S China Sea
content: a US Navy guided-missile destroyer spent four days without working toilets, galley services . the ship suffered an "engineering casualty involving its generators," a spokesperson says . no injuries were reported aboard the ship in the south china sea .

title: 'Will rise for it, won't sing it': Congress MP Masood explains stand on Vande Mataram
content: imran Masood refuses to sing Vande Mataram, citing his constitutional right to practise his religion . he said he would respect the national song but would not sing it . his statement comes amid row over recitation of the song involving grand old party .

title: Amit Shah hails crackdown on ISI-backed Shahzad Bhatti network
content: more than 200 operatives were arrested and plans for subversive attacks were thwarted . he said coordinated operations were carried out across 14 states to dismantle the network . the network was involved in espionage, including grenades bearing Pakistan Ordnance Factory markings .
